title: Power Apps: out-of-the-box Application Insights telemetry for generative pages
notes: claim 42: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: the export prerequisite, telemetry signals, roadmap dates and Azure billing are supported. Microsoft does not explicitly guarantee no autonomous actions or no user-visible effects; those assurances should be removed. The export path stops early, and the checklist names controls missing from the table.

claims.claim: Configuring environment Application Insights export automatically exports telemetry for published generative pages.
claims.quote: When you configure Application Insights data export for the environment in the Power Platform admin center, Power Apps automatically exports telemetry for published generative pages.
claims.fix: Retain the feature-specific statement, but add: 'The troubleshooting article says exports need manual scheduling, unlike the automatic export described by the generative-pages documentation.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/troubleshoot/power-platform/dataverse/import-export-data/data-export-option-not-available-in-application-insights, which says 'Users need to manually schedule exports.'

claims.claim: There are no autonomous actions and the feature only observes activity.
claims.quote: Searched: generative pages Application Insights autonomous performance telemetry. Read generative-pages, analyze-telemetry and returned excerpts; they describe exported signals, not an explicit guarantee that the feature only observes or performs no actions.
claims.fix: Replace 'None. The feature only observes activity.' with 'The documented capability exports page-load, error, data-operation and navigation telemetry.'

claims.claim: For workspace-based Application Insights resources the effective daily cap is the minimum of the two settings.
claims.quote: For workspace-based Application Insights resources, the effective daily cap is the minimum of the two settings.

claims.claim: The environment export path is Power Platform admin center > Manage > Data export > App Insights > New data export.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. In the Manage pane, select Data export. On the Data export page, select the App Insights tab. Then select New data export.
claims.fix: Keep the documented path, which correctly reaches the export wizard, and add to the note: 'In the wizard, select the data type and filters, select the source environment, select the destination Azure subscription, resource group and Application Insights environment, then review and create the export.'
